parole.testo: Variant of liippi, lippi, borrowed from North Germanic (compare Norwegian glip, Danish glib), ultimately from Proto-Germanic *glīpaną.

parole.significato: snow and rime that accumulates on tree branches and any solid structures in certain climatic conditions
parole.testo: Borrowed from a North Germanic language, compare Old Norse þykkr (“thick, bulky”), from Proto-Germanic *þekuz. Karelian tykky has the same origin.
